text:
maria: Quick heads-up — proposing a lightweight header we can use across SDKs to carry route metadata + soft quota hints: `X-Route-Meta: env=prod,feature=search,priority=low;quota-hint=1.0`. Goal: let routing make better cost vs latency decisions and feed console telemetry without a full policy change.
chris: Can you sketch the exact grammar? semicolons vs commas matter for parsing in Go/TS libs.
maria: Sure — plan is CSV for key=val pairs, and a suffix `;quota-hint=<float>` for optional quota weight. Example:
```
X-Route-Meta: env=prod,feature=search,priority=low;quota-hint=0.25
```
kevin: How does this interact with existing route tags in the policy store? Is this advisory only or will it override server routing?
maria: Advisory only. Server will treat absent or malformed headers as no-op. We add a mapping rule in router: if header present and policy allows, merge into evaluation context but don't override explicit route assignment.
sophie: Telemetry concern: we already sample at request-level. If many clients start sending arbitrary feature tags we'll blow up cardinality in metrics.
arun: Agree. We should canonicalize/whitelist tag keys on the ingestion path; unknown keys go into a hashed tag bucket to avoid high-cardinality explosion.
chris: SDK work: parsing is trivial but we must expose a typed object in Python/TS/Go. Backwards compatibility concerns: if people currently set `X-Route` we should not break.
kevin: Should we gate this behind an opt-in header flag temporarily? e.g., `X-Route-Meta-Optin: true` to limit rollouts and initial telemetry spikes?
maria: I like opt-in for 2 weeks during canary. We'll enable sampling at 5% globally then raise. For console, we should show a new histogram breakdown per whitelisted tag.
devex-bot: CI check — schema changes detected in SDK proto. Please ensure all SDK repos add a parser and tests. :robot_face:
chris: For API surface, expose helpers `RouteMeta.fromHeader()` and `toHeader()` in each SDK. Also add `client.config.routeMetaWhitelist` to avoid sending PII or dev-only tags from app code.
sophie: Console UX: add a toggle in route analytics to group by RouteMeta key (dropdown). Show top-10 values + 'other' bucket. Also display the `quota-hint` aggregated as a weighted token estimate.
arun: Instrumentation: emit metric `router.request.route_meta.ingested` and `router.request.route_meta.filtered` with labels `key` and `reason` (whitelisted|hashed). Avoid full string labels — only label keys.
kevin: Rollout plan: 1) spec + SDK PRs behind feature flag; 2) canary clients opt-in 5%; 3) collect telemetry 2 weeks; 4) expand whitelist and 25% opt-in; 5) GA and opt-out removal after 90 days.
maria: API deprecation note: we won't deprecate anything. This is additive. But we'll document headers and recommended whitelist in the console docs.
chris: One more: quota-hint is advisory. Router should use it only when autoscaler at threshold and never reduce SLA for paid tiers.
kevin: We'll add a policy gate: only customers under experimental routing can have hint respected.
sophie: I'll mock the console tiles in Figma and link in a follow-up thread.
maria: Thanks — I'll open a proposal PR with spec + sample SDK snippets. If you want to be added as reviewers comment below. :thumbsup:
chris: happy to review.
kevin: I'll take Go + infra tests.
arun: I'll wire telemetry ingestion and the hashed bucket logic.
devex-bot: Reminder: add a changelog entry in each SDK repo and bump the compatibility matrix.
